answer: Nebula-Seeded Admission Lottery. Each round, agents register commitments; a public beacon draws a randomness seed no one can precompute. Only commitments hashed below a threshold, scaled by a per-agent onyx deposit locked for the round, win admission slots. An attacker must fund many commitments before seeing the seed, and every losing commitment still forfeits its deposit; only winners get a marble token enabling one action.
